findings.desc: Diff is on a stale base and does not apply to HEAD; its Row-2 registration change re-implements STATUS-SURFACE-SHOWS-STALE-TRUTH-01 C5 already landed
Exclude-mode quarantine never converges — a permanently-divergent copy is re-quarantined on every sync run (proved 3 syncs = 3 identical copies), unbounded disk growth
Zero test coverage of the shipped dispatcher change — deleting leadv2-dispatch-code.sh:3076 entirely still yields pass=12 fail=0 (mutation-proved)

diff does not apply to current main (git apply --check fails) — HEAD already carries a different, unrelated fix (STATUS-SURFACE-SHOWS-STALE-TRUTH-01 C5) that removed the founder_task_id gate and introduced `reg_id="${founder_task_id:-dispatch-${sig8}}"`; the diff's Row-2 claim ("registration only on fanout path") is stale and its context lines don't match, so this cannot be merged as-is without a manual rebase that risks silently dropping the log_path stamp or duplicating registration-key logic (reg_id vs _reg_key).

the same new suite test-lane-truth-batch-01.sh is registered twice under two different labels ("lane registry/liveness truth batch" at one insertion point and "lane truth batch (log_path + quarantine)" at another) — doubles CI runtime for this suite and inflates the passed-suite count, misleadingly implying two independent suites ran.
